summary: Tested all 23 items in the Kids Universe Phase 2-4 review request: 18 backend endpoint tests (kids-journey progress/unlock/star/album/emotion/cron + admin letter-of-admission) and 6 frontend flows (map view, Day 1 Storytelling Sanctum room, free-user pricing CTA, locked stone unlock modal, zone tab switching, Back to the Path). 100% pass after fixing one MongoDB ObjectId leak in /star/commit and re-inserting the expired test session row.

minor.issue: Returned ObjectId in response causing 500 (FastAPI jsonable_encoder TypeError). FIXED by testing agent: doc.pop('_id', None) after insert_one.

action_items: None — all functionality verified. The ObjectId leak fix in kids_universe_endpoints.py is the only code change required and was already applied by the testing agent.
critical_code_review_comments: kids_universe_endpoints.py star/commit returned the raw post-insert doc which Motor mutates with ObjectId _id; should preferably build response dict explicitly rather than ** spread to avoid same class of bug. Same pattern is fine for other endpoints because they exclude _id at fetch time, but be cautious for any future insert_one + return pattern.
kids_universe_endpoints.py uses inline JSON shape constants — fine for current size (489 LOC); within file-size guideline.
Premium gating relies on presence_seconds_left>0 OR body_temple_unlock OR clarity pass; verified through real user user_angel_test_c01ba5. No hardcoded credentials in code, env vars used correctly.
All interactive frontend elements have data-testid attributes — excellent testability.

rca of the issue: Backend 500 on /api/kids-journey/star/commit (only on the first INSERT branch, not on the existing-row branch): Motor's collection.insert_one(doc) mutates doc to add MongoDB-generated ObjectId in '_id'. Endpoint then returned {'ok': True, **doc} which leaked the ObjectId; FastAPI jsonable_encoder cannot serialize ObjectId → 500. Reproduced via pytest. Mitigation applied: doc.pop('_id', None) directly after insert_one() in /api/kids-journey/star/commit handler in /app/backend/kids_universe_endpoints.py.
